title: Area of a Plane Region Cut Out by a Cylinder
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Find the surface area of the plane 2x + 2y + z = 8 inside the cylinder x^2 + y^2 <= 4.

steps.title: Calculate Area Scale Factor
steps.mathExpression: z = 8 - 2x - 2y \implies z_x = -2, \; z_y = -2; \quad d\sigma = \sqrt{1 + (-2)^2 + (-2)^2} \, dA = \sqrt{9} \, dA = 3 \, dA
steps.explanation: The surface element scales the base area by constant factor 3.

steps.title: Multiply Scale Factor by Base Circular Area
steps.explanation: Multiply factor 3 by area of disk 4*pi.
